items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: and that was Maude Reid, who was a nurse at the school where I went.

ctx.x: I get so excited when I talk about it. Ralph Edwards came out and said, yes, yes, yes, something, we're going to have fun tonight. And then here comes a voice saying, "It's been a long time, Nellie Lutcher --," something, "since I looked down your throat in Lake Charles, Louisiana," or something. Then it hit me and I sat there and I looked and I looked, and I thought what is this voice coming from some foreign place, you know. And I looked and looked, and then finally she said, yes, and I think it was the first…
